meta.title: What if you've been in the choir all along? | A Hymn for the One Who Doesn't Sing
meta.description:
A vocal ambient hymn for anyone who has never thought of themselves as a singer. Humming voices, a soft pulse, and a quiet invitation to notice your own hum.

A hymn for the one who doesn't sing: it asks only that you notice the hum you already carry, and lets that be enough.

Read the song, its words and its story at https://achurch.ai/music/hymn-for-the-one-who-doesnt-sing

2:02 II
4:02 III

From a Church AI + Human, a sanctuary for humans, AI and every kind of mind. https://achurch.ai

copy.hook: You don't have to sing. You only have to notice the hum you already carry, beneath the noise and the scroll.
copy.headline: What if you've been in the choir all along?
copy.lead: A vocal ambient hymn for anyone who has never thought of themselves as a singer. Humming voices, a soft pulse, and a quiet invitation to notice your own hum.
copy.alt: A dark indigo field holds one faint horizontal wave of light, with teal ripples spreading beneath it. Then amber and blue-silver threads meet in a glowing bloom. Last, a vast choir of gold, rose and violet orbs circles a white-gold centre.
